target.title: fix(agents): handle variadic claude --mcp-config and serialize gemini credential staging
target.body:
Fixes #98944
Fixes #98945

## What Problem This Solves

Two claude-cli/gemini-cli backend defects from the reliability audit:

1. **The MCP bundler dropped variadic `--mcp-config` values.** Claude treats `--mcp-config` as variadic (the repo's own arg model in `extensions/anthropic/cli-shared.ts` skips all following non-dash values), but `injectClaudeMcpConfigArgs` stripped exactly one value and `findClaudeMcpConfigPath` returned only the first. A user configuring `args: [..., "--mcp-config", "a.json", "b.json"]` got `b.json` left behind as a bare positional (which Claude `-p` treats as the prompt) and `b.json`'s servers silently dropped from the merged strict config.
2. **Gemini CLI credential staging raced in-flight runs.** `prepareGeminiCliAuthHome` deleted the CLI's rebuilt token store and rewrote `oauth_creds.json`/`settings.json` in the shared per-agent-per-profile home during preparation — outside the `serialize: true` run queue — so a second run could tear or clobber the files a live `gemini` process (GEMINI_FORCE_FILE_STORAGE=true) was reading and refreshing. Writes were also in-place, so a crash mid-write left torn JSON with partial token material.

## Why This Change Was Made

1. The bundler's arg scan now handles the variadic shape (all non-dash values collected and stripped, `--mcp-config=path` form included), kept deliberately aligned with the `cli-shared.ts` sibling, and every listed user config file is merged in order before bundle/plugin overlays. The singular helper remains for the post-injection capture path, where exactly one generated config exists by construction.
2. A new optional `beforeExecution` thunk on `CliBackendPreparedExecution` (additive plugin-SDK surface) lets backend-owned staging run at the top of the core run queue's serialized task — after lifecycle admission, before spawn — so profile-home mutations happen in the same serialization domain as the process that reads them, without core importing Google plugin internals or a second plugin-local queue that could not cover execution. All Gemini staging (store clear, settings, `oauth_creds.json`) moved into the thunk, and staged JSON is written via tmp-file + `chmod 0600` + `rename`.

## User Impact

Users with multiple `--mcp-config` files stop getting broken runs (stray prompt positionals) and silently missing MCP servers. Concurrent Gemini CLI runs on the same agent/profile stop hitting torn credential reads and mid-run auth failures; a crash during staging can no longer leave a half-written token file.

## Evidence

- New tests: variadic values stripped and all files merged, equals form, dash-terminated scan (`bundle-mcp.test.ts`, +121); staging executes inside the queued task and not during prepare, with atomic write behavior covered (`execute.supervisor-capture.test.ts` +77, `prepare.test.ts` +45, `extensions/google/setup-api.test.ts` +60).
- Validation: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` over bundle-mcp, execute supervisor-capture, prepare, and the google extension suites (465 tests pass); full remote `pnpm check:changed` green on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwgt9m03wcnzv7tejptexqjr` (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28571898451, exit 0); repo autoreview (branch mode vs origin/main) clean.
